title: 3 flights of stairs a day makes your heart 17% fitter
excerpt: A 2025 study found that climbing stairs just 3 times a day — each under 2 minutes — increased cardiovascular fitness by 17.1%. No gym, no equipment, no excuses.

title: 4.5 minutes a day cuts cancer risk by 32%
excerpt: New research shows non-exercisers who do brief bursts of vigorous activity throughout the day dramatically reduce their cancer risk. No gym required.
